app.header:
# 🎼 YuE2 Song Studio
Compose in symbols, create in sound — every song comes with a score you can read, play, and change.
app.footer: Powered by [YuE2](https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE). Personal creators may use and monetize outputs; commercial use by companies needs a license. Crediting #YuE2 is appreciated.
create.intro: Write lyrics, describe the sound, and YuE2 writes a melody-and-chord score, then sings it.
create.review_first: Let me review the score before recording
create.review_first_info: Stops after the score is written so you can listen to it, edit it, or record it as is.
style.extra_placeholder: e.g. rainy night, airy reverb, big final chorus
style.prompt_info: Built from your choices above — you can also edit it directly.
field.title: Title
field.lyrics_info: Use section tags like [Verse] and [Chorus]. The song's length follows the lyrics.
field.mode_info: Full plans melody and chords (editable). Melody plans only the tune. No score is fastest but gives nothing to edit.
field.seed_info: -1 picks a new random take each time; reuse a number to repeat a take.
status.planned: Score ready. Listen to it below, then record it or open it in the editor.
status.transcribed: Melody score ready. Choose it in step 2 to make a cover.
note.truncated: The model reached its length limit, so the song may end abruptly. Shorter lyrics help.
note.chords_free: Chords were removed so the accompaniment could follow the new style.
note.transfer: Moved {moved} vocal notes to the instrument part and kept {kept} original instrument notes.
restyle.intro: Keep a song's melody and hear it in a completely different style.
restyle.lyrics_info: Prefilled from the original. Change words freely, but keep a similar number of syllables per line.
restyle.keep_chords_info: Off (recommended): only the melody is kept, so the band can re-harmonize it for the new genre.
editor.intro: Change the melody, chords, tempo, or key in the score, then record it as a new version. The original is never overwritten.
editor.valid: Valid score · {bpm} BPM · key {key} · {meter} · {measures} bars · about {seconds}s
editor.invalid: This score cannot be used yet: {detail}
editor.style_info: The sound to render with — change it too if you like.
editor.lyrics_info: Keep one syllable per sung note where possible.
editor.help:
- `Q:1/4=88` — tempo in BPM · `K:C` — key · `M:4/4` — meter
- `"Am7"` — a chord symbol above the next note (only in the Vocal part)
- `V: Vocal` is the sung melody, `V: Ins` is the instrumental melody
- Notes: `c d e` (higher octave: `c'`, lower: `C`), sharps `^c`, flats `_e`; the number after a note is its length in 1/32 notes (`c8` = a quarter note)
- `z8` is a rest, `Z` is a whole bar of rest, `-` ties a note into the next
- Every line must contain whole bars; use **Check score** before recording.
instrumental.intro: Background music without vocals: describe a mood, or turn a song from your library into an instrumental.
instrumental.keep_chords_info: The vocal melody moves to an instrument; chords keep the same harmony.
instrumental.plan_mode_info: How YuE2 writes the score when starting from a description.
cover.intro: Re-imagine a melody: extract it from a recording (or paste an ABC score), then sing it with new words or play it as an instrumental.
cover.start_info: Where the part you want begins
cover.length_info: Up to 240 s; 30–90 s works best
cover.keep_harmony_info: Off: only the melody is kept, so the new arrangement is free.
cover.lyrics_info: Write new words under each section tag. Match the phrasing of the melody for the best result.
cover.rights: Only use recordings you have the rights to. A cover keeps the melody; it does not copy the original voice or recording.
library.intro: Every result is saved as a version. Pick one to listen, see where it came from, or continue from it.
library.col.title: Title
library.empty: Select a song in the table.

error.lyrics_required: Write some lyrics. For music without words, use the Instrumental tab.
error.review_needs_score: Reviewing needs a score — choose Full or Melody planning.
error.song_missing: That song is not in the library.
error.song_no_score: That song has no score to work from (it was made without score planning).
error.no_plan: This song has no saved score plan to record.

error.plan_truncated: The model could not finish the score. Please try again.
error.reference_required: Upload a recording or paste an ABC score.
error.clip_out_of_range: The start time is past the end of the recording.
error.clip_too_short: The selected part is too short (at least 5 seconds).
error.cover_lyrics_required: Write lyrics for a sung cover (words under the section tags).
error.no_audio: This song has no audio yet.
